note: USACE Wilson Lake campground on the open north shore, spread over a grassy point, a middle loop and a north-east area, plus a few primitive sites on a point 2 km south; 30- and 50-amp electric sites, some with water, gravel pads, showers and a dump station; swim area and boat ramp. --Claude
summary: Rates updated to $18-26 (2026 peak), off-season first-come $20 electric. Added the reservation season (May 15-Sep 15), 14-night limit and weekend/holiday minimums. Year-round with off-season first-come. Count 96 -> 90 RV sites, pull-through. Added showers, flush and vault toilets, water and dump, and the military discount. Hookups (50 A, water) confirmed. Lakefront stands.
flags: WATERFRONT (stored lakefront) holds on the per-site coordinates. SW point: sites 010, 011, 013, 014 and 016 sit 10-20 m from the riprap shoreline across open grass, with the loop road inland of them and no day use between. NE area: sites 066, 068, 069 and 070 are 10-20 m from the shore across open ground. The middle loop (040-057) is 20-60 m back.

Phone: rec.gov lists none; the stored 785-658-2551 (presumably the Wilson Lake project office) is unconfirmed this pass because the USACE Wilson Lake page returned 403 and was not retried. Website stands (https://www.recreation.gov/camping/campgrounds/233547).

Split question: rec.gov carries 7 primitive non-electric units (096-102, plus tent site 105) on a separate point ~2.1 km south (centroid ~38.9292,-98.5310), reached by its own gravel road. They are primitive with no posted length and part of the same rec.gov facility, so the default is no split; flag for AWH if he wants that point separate. The NE area is ~1 km from the SW point but on the same internal park road, so no split.

Fees: the walk-in season lists STANDARD NONELECTRIC at $0 (probably a placeholder, though non-electric may be free off-season), so nightly_low stays at the $18 peak non-electric rate. Stored 'sites up to 148 ft' comes from the catalog's Max Vehicle Length and is kept as stated.
Pin 38.948,-98.519 is on the SW point's shore ~15 m from site 013; fine. No sand issue (riprap and grass shore).
